$comment: Every judge returns exactly one JSON object of this shape (write it to .lab/runs/<run>/judges/<judge>.json).

pass.description: score >= the judge's pass threshold AND no blocker issues

fix.description: concrete, actionable change (file + what to change)

element.description: visual-fidelity: what the issue is about, one word: an element name from design/reference/inventory.md (e.g. plough, house) or one of palette, lighting, camera, world, polish. Panels group issues by it.

criteria.description: per-criterion 0-10 scores from the rubric table (required by visual-fidelity), so a change between rounds can be traced to a criterion

keyart_bullets.description: visual-fidelity only: the judge's description of the reference (method step 1), to see whether judges read the reference the same way
